A small set of English tokens with cognate/foreign overlap (' wondered', ' acknowledge', ' known') and the abbreviation 'i.e.' also trigger it moderately, while near-neighbors (' asked', 'viz.', 'e.g.', English '-est' words) respond weakly or not at all.
